# Security Policy

## Portfolio scope

This repository is a public professional portfolio. Client projects, commercial systems, credentials and production secrets are intentionally kept outside this repository.

## Secrets

Do not commit or publish:

- `.env` files;
- API keys or access tokens;
- database credentials;
- OAuth secrets;
- private client information;
- production-only configuration.

Use environment variables and provider secret stores for sensitive configuration.

## Reporting a security issue

If you identify a security or privacy issue related to this portfolio, contact Lucas Nassuato da Silva privately instead of publishing credentials or sensitive details in a public issue.

Contact: lucasnassuato2025@gmail.com
